item.title: about me
item.description: Thanks for stopping by! I am a consultant, climate scientist, geospatial AI modeler and data visualization practitioner with 11+ years in delivering climate, AI, energy, sustainability and good governance targeted projects across various sectors. I trained for 6 years in climate science from my undergraduate years as a BS Applied Physics major, and earned my Masters in Atmospheric Science from Ateneo de Manila University last 2019. My topics of interest include regional monsoon dynamics, extreme heat, data validation techniques, climate model evaluation and agent-based modelling.
